༄༅/ /lo glud du grags pa'i lo rim sde brgyad spyi mchod char 'bebs sad ser bsrung ba dang bcas pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅//lo glud du grags pa'i lo rim sde brgyad spyi mchod char

'bebs sad ser bsrung ba dang bcas pa bzhugs/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdus sde brgyad yongs kyi rje/ /gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang ba'i bdag /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /'dir lo rim la dmigs te 'jig rten pa'i mgron mchod tshul zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang rgyas par na/ stegs ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dbus su 'jim pa sogs las zheng mtho gang*/ dpangs su sor bzhi lhag tsam gyi ri rab gru bzhi pa/ steng gi mtshams bzhir snyug ma sogs btsugs pa'i steng du dar 'phan gyi rnam pa dang*/ phyogs bzhi tshon skud sogs kyis sbrel nas brgyan/ ri rab kyi dbus su phyag rdor gyi tsa ka li 'bru'i tshom bu dang bcas pa/ phyogs mtshams rnams su tshom bu grangs mang tsam dgod/ ri rab kyi phyi mtha'i phyogs bzhir glud dang gtor chung ci 'grub dang*/ ting lo/ gser skyems/ dkar phud/ ja phud/ chang phud/ lo phud/ me togashing thoga'abru sna/ zas sna/ sman sna/ gos sna/ sha sna/ khrag sna yang bya bar bshad/ de'i mthar srog chags kyi gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang*/ ril bu 'chang bu/ mtheb kyu rnams ci 'grub byas nas mtha' bskor na mdzes/ mdun du gtor ma zlum po dkar gsum mngar gsum dang bcas pa'i mthar gtor chung mtheb kyu dang bcas pa dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs ci 'byor bshams la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid 'jigs byed/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ 'gur drag sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed/ 'dir 'jig rten pa mchod tshul gtso bor byed pa yin yang*/ thog mar 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams tshogs zhing gi tshul du byas nas mchod na legs pas/ de'i tshul ni/ mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /dpal bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung tshogs bcas la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /chos 'khor bskor phyir rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /'dis mtshon dge ba ji snyed bsags pa rnams/ /bla med byang chub dam pa thob phyir bsngo/ /bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa la/ /bdag cag re bltos 'cha' zhing gsol 'debs kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi mthun rkyen kun 'grub mdzod/ /khyad par yul 'di'i lo thog rgyas pa la/ /bar gcod than ser gnod pa zhi ba dang*/ /lo legs 'bru bcud phun sum tshogs gyur te/ /longs spyod dga' bde'i dpal la 'god par mdzod/ /de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer spyod/ rol mo 'dod yon la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shapta dang*/ rū pa nas/ sparsha āḥhūṃ/ mchod rdzas gzhan rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yo byad kyi mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi yo byad sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang zhing*/ mgron rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i byed las dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun nam gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddha dharmāḥte badzra siddhi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwā mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tatkhaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam/ rgyas par na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab bya zhing*/ mjug tu/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyis 'don pa'i byin brlabs kyang bya'o/ /de nas mgron rnams ri rab kyi steng du bskyed chog rgyas pa byas nas spyan drangs te bstims yang legs mod/ 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol bar byas na/ de nas ri rab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ yongs su gyur pa las sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su suṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i ri rab mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ri rab lhun po'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams sogs rang rang so so'i gnas mchog nas/ lha klu sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ ༈ /dzaḥ tshangs pa la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /brgya byin la sogs lha chen brgyad/ /spyan 'dren=/ nor rgyas la sogs klu chen brgyad/ spyan 'dren=/ /sgra gcan la sogs gza' chen brgyad/ /spyan 'dren=/ /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar rnams/ /spyan 'dren=/ yul khor srung sogs rgya chen bzhi/ /spyan 'dren=/ /lha chen la sogs 'jigs byed dgu/ /spyan 'dren=/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /sa bdag rgyal po thams cad dang*/ /dri za gshin rje srin po rnams/ /spyan 'dren=/ /chu bdag rlung lha gnod sbyin dang*/ 'byung po sha za rgyal po btsan/ /bdud dang 'byung po the'u rang rnams/ /spyan 'dren=/ /mdor na srid pa gsum 'di na/ /lha klu drang srong mthu rtsal can/ /sde brgyad rigs su gtogs pa kun/

/spyan 'dren=/ /khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*/ /dkor bdag mgron du 'os pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren=/ /'dir byon ri rab chen po'i steng*/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan rnams la/ /'tshe ba'i sems bral phan dgos kyis/ /dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e hye hi sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi mchod pa dang*/ / bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo bzhes nas srung skyob mdzod/ /oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar nas zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo'i bar dang*/ 'dod yon rnams 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo rin chen sogs/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang*/ /rin chen gdugs dang gser nya sogs/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad bcas pa rnams/ /'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas la/ / 'bul lo bzhes nas srung skyob mdzod/ /oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra ma hā sapta ratna aṣta maṅga laṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes 'bul/ gnyis pa ni/ ༈ /kyai/ 'jig rten skyong mdzad mthu rtsal can/ /tshangs pa dbang po la sogs pa/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud gtor ma mar me dang*/ /gser skyems dkar phud ja chang phud/ /lo phud me tog shing thog sman/ /'bru sna zas gos dar sna dang*/ /srog chags gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang*/ /ril bu 'chang bu bcas te 'bul/ /bzhes nas yul khams lo tog la/ /gnod pa'i than ser sogs zhi zhing*/ /longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i=/ longs spyod=/ nor rgyas dung skyong la sogs pa/

/klu chen brgyad po=/ lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ sgra gcan nyi ma zla ba sogs/ gza' chen brgyad po=/ lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ smin drug snar ma la sogs pa/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /yo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than=/ longs spyod dpal=/ yul 'khor srung la sogs pa yi/ rgyal chen bzhi bo 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal=/ lha chen drag po la sogs pa/ /'jigs byed dgu po 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /sa bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ dri za gshin rje srin po sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i gdon gyi rigs rnams la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ rgyal po btsan dang sha za bdud/ /ma mo the'u rang tshogs rnams la/ /lo glud=/ gser skyems= /lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ser=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor=/ srid gsum 'di na rgyu byed pa'i/ / sde brgyad rigs su gtogs kun la/ lo glud=/ gser skyems=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i than ther=/ longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas pa=/

yul phyogs 'di ru gnas rgyu ba'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud=/ gser=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas=/ gnod pa'i=/ longs spyod dpal=/ khyad par drang srong ra hu la/ /sprul pa'i gza' tshogs 'khor bcas dang*/ stag srin zor ba'i gdong la sogs/ /gdong can bzhi po thams cad la/ /lo glud=/ gser=/ lo phud=/ 'bru sna=/ srog chags=/ ril bu=/ bzhes nas yul 'di'i lo tog la/ /gnod pa'i thog ser mi gtong bar/ /lo tog 'bru bcud 'phel ba dang*/ /longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /de ni cung zad rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de las bsdu na/ kyai/ 'jig rten skyong ba mthu rtsal can/ /tshangs pa la sogs phyaugs skyong bcu/ /brgya byin la sogs lha chen brgyad/ /nor rgyas la sogs klu chen brgyad/ /sgra gcan la sogs gza' chen brgyad/ /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar rnams/ /yul 'khor srung sogs rgyal chen bzhi/ /lha chen la sogs 'jigs byed dgu/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /sa bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /lo glud ces sogs sbyar ba dang*/ yang*/ dri za gshin rje srin po sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /rgyal po 'dre btsan sha za bdud/ /ma mo the'u rang la sogs pa/ /sde brgyad rigs su gtogs kun dang*/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad la/ /lo glud sogs dang*/ khyad par drang srong ra hu la/ /zhes sogs sbyar te bsdus nas phul chog cing*/ grub na lan gsum bdun sogs grangs mang du brjod de phul na legs te/ dper na bskang gso grangs mang po brjod na legs pa bzhin no/ /de nas/ gtor ma byin brlab bya ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba li tā kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan nyer gcig gam/ bdun gyi phul te/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ni dpal mgon don snga la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas yul phyogs 'di'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srung skyob mdzad pa dang*/ lo tog la gnod pa'i than ser sad la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ 'bru bcud sogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong spyi'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma spyi ltar btang yang legs/ bgegs gtor gtong bar 'dod na cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar lo tog la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs bkug nas gtor ma btang ste gshegs/ rgyas par na 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la gtor ma lan bdun sogs phul rjes/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /zhes sogs brjod na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ hūṃ/ srid gsum 'di na mthu che zhing*/ gnam sa bar snang khams kun la/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis dbang bsgyur ba/ /phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*/ /rgya mtsho che la rtag rol ba'i/ /klu chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bar snang khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /gza' chen brgyad po thams cad dang*/ /legs nyes mtshan ma ston mdzad pa'i/ /rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bzhir 'jig rten skyong mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor bcas dang*/ /sde brgyad tshogs kyi rjer gyur pa/ /'jigs byed dgu la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/sa chen khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /sa bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas dang*/ /phyogs bcu'i gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /sde brgyad rigs su gtogs la dud/ /khyed rnams mchod cing bstod byas pas/ /sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la/ /gnod pa'i mi mthun zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod don thams cad sgrubs/ /khyad par yul 'di'i lo tog la/ /gnod pa'i than ser ngan pa sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*/ /rtsi bcud lo tog rgyas par mdzod/ /kyai/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum po yis/ /phyogs 'di'i lo tog la gnod pa'i/ /than ser mi mthun zhi ba dang*/ 'bru bcud lo tog rgyas par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas kyis/ /yul 'di'i lo tog la gnod pa'i/ /than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ lha chen brgyad po=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ klu chen brgyad po=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ gza' chen brgyad po=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ rgyal chen bzhi po=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ 'jigs byed dgu po=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru=/ sa bdag chen po 'khor=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ phyogs bcu'i gdon rigs 'khor=/ yul 'di'i=/ than ser=/ 'bru bcud=/ yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /yul 'di'i lo tog la gnod pa'i/ /than ser mi mthun zhi ba dang*/ / 'bru bcud lo tog rgyas par mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bcol/ mthar bzod gsol byas nas gshegs pa ni/ kyai/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa yi/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad tshogs/ /khyed rnams spyan drangs mchod skabs 'dir/ /nongs pa'i nyes kun bzod par gsol/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs mdzod la/ /so so'i rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /rang gi gnas nas yul khams 'dir/ /srung dang skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /badzra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/

ces brjod cing bsams la/ bkra shis sogs brjod par bya'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i bca' thabs rgyas pa de bzhin ma grub na ni/ ri rab kyi steng du shing leb kyi steng du shog ras sogs bting ba la tshom bu ci 'grub bkod nas/ de'i mthar glud gtor sogs mtshon byed tsam byas te/ mchod tshul gong gi rgyas bsdus gang rung bzhin byas kyang rung tsam mo/ /lo rim tshul la rnam mang yang*/ /'phral gyi rkyen sel mthun sgrub la/ /'di ltar mchod bstod 'phrin bcol ba/ /mchod tshul gzhan las lhag gam snyam/ /ces lo glud du grags pa'i lo rim du dmigs nas 'jig rten pa'i sde brgyad chen po spyi la dmigs nas mchod tshul 'di ni/ g.yo sa'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang rab brtan sogs gzhan 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis dpe snga ma gsum tsam mthong yang ma 'brel ba dang ma tshang ba che 'dug pas/ dpal mgon 'di dag mdo sngags kyi phyogs gnyis ka nas 'byung zhing grags che bar ma zad/ gzhan ban bon rnams kyis kyang bkur zhing mchod 'dug pas khyad che bar bsams nas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ / maṅgalaṃ// //'dir sngon ma'i zhor la char 'beb byed tshul dang*/ ser ba srung ba'i tshul mdor bsdus zhig brjod pa la/ spyi char 'bebs byed tshul rgyas pa ni/ 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs gzhung chen po du ma las klu chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bris te bsgrubs shing mchod cing bskul ba'i sgo nas byed pa dang*/ rdo rje'i mchu dang*/ sprin chen po'i mdo sogs nas kyang char 'bebs byed pa'i cho ga bshad pa ni de dag tu shes par bya la/ gzhan man ngag zur pa thar thor ni shin tu mang ngo*/ /gzhung chen mo dag las gsungs pa'i char 'bebs de dag lag len tshul bzhin sgrub nus na ni shin tu legs mod/ da lta'i gang zag bya sla ba la dga' bas ji lta ba bzhin lag tu len dka' bar mthong ngo*/

/dmigs brtse ma la brten pa'i char 'bebs byed tshul rgyas pa ni de'i cho ga las shes par bya zhing*/ de bsdus pa byed tshul ni/ klu sman sna tshogs dang bsres pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas pa bum pa'i nang du blugs te/ de la dmigs nas dmigs brtse ma brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ bsangs btang ste char 'bebs pa'i gsol gdab bya ba dang*/ bum pa de nyid klu yod pa'i chu mig tu bzhag nas klu la char 'bebs kyi bskul ma bya'o/ /'dir sprin chen nas 'byung ba 'ga' zhig gtso bor byas te brjod na/ char 'bebs byed pa'i skabs dag tu mchod pa dang bcas na rab dang*/ min yang*/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad sprin gyi snying po can la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin du thams cad la sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs las byung ba sprin gyis rnam par mdzes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu 'dzin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ldan sprin gyi gzi brjid la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'byung ba la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i sprin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' dpag med la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen tshogs grogs 'bar ba'i tshogs la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen mthu rtsal dpa' bo la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin mdzes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling du char rab tu 'bebs par mdzad du gsol lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdug chen po la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi 'od la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen seṅge la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gdugs la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa blta sdug sprin chen la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen pos khebs pa la=/

de bzhin gshegs pa sprin las byung ba snang bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu mtho 'gebs rda'i sgra dbyangs shin tu rab sgrogs la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen bsil 'byung mi dga' rab tu 'joms pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'dal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su=/ 'dzambu'i gling du=/ de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i chu sprin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal gyi sprin ltar dpa' bo la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra bsgrags pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin kun tu ston pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rgya chen po la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'dzag la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par sgrogs la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa ltar 'phags la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin lta bu'i na bza' mnabs la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyis lo tog bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su=/ 'dzambu'i gling du=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi gnas la gnas pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa char sprin gyi sprin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'du ba mdzad la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rnam par rgyas pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen utpal la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen chos kyi sku la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'phags la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dbang phyug la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'od mdzad la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen byin la=/ mchod do/ / skyabs su=/ 'dzambu'i gling du/ de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu rin po che chen po'i sprin lta bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par 'joms pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu ba la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdud la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus ma yin pa'i sprin dang lce 'bab pa rnam par 'joms pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po ltar nam mkha'i mthongs nas bsgrags pa la=/

de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen sgra 'byin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen chu skyes la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa snyems pa'i gzi brjid sgrub pa'i sprin la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa ro bro ba drug dang ldan pa'i chu chen po'i sprin la=/ mchod do/ /skyabs su=/ 'dzambu'i gling du char rab tu=/ de bzhin gshegs pa chu 'thor sprin chen la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rgya mtsho 'gengs pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa char mi 'bebs pa na sprin gyis kun tu 'gebs pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gzugs mtha' yas la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po thams cad rnam par sgrub pa 'dzambu'i sprin gyi dpal gyi gzi brjid 'od mdzad pa sprin gyi 'od zer can la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla baiḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la=/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /'dzambu'i gling 'dir=/ 'phags pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la=/ 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad la=/ 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la=/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la=/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dzambu'i gling 'dir char rab tu 'bebs par mdzad du gsol lo/ /klu'i rgyal po chen po g.yogs mtha' yas rgya mtsha'i sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la mchod cing yang dag par bskul lo/ /yul phyogs 'di dag tu char rab tu phob cig swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan re re la sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' la mchod cing yang dag par=/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mcho dang ma dros pa la=/

klu'i rgyal po gzi can dang chu lha la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang yul 'khor srung la mchod cing yang dag par bskul lo/ /'dzambu'i gling 'dir=/ klu'i rgyal po btang bzung dang sa srung gi bu la=/ klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu dang dpal gyi gzi brjid la=/ klu'i rgyal po dpal bzang dang glog gi 'phreng ba la=/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu rin po che dang gtsug na nor bu thogs pa la mchod cing yang ==/ klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud can dang gtsug 'jal can la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs 'di dag tu=/ klu'i rgyal po dbang po'i rgyal mtshan dang dbang po'i mchod sdong la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan dang bkra shis ldan la=/ klu'i rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po can dang lag gi 'gro ba chen po la=/ klu'i rgyal po skar mdog dang zla ba'i gzi brjid la=/ klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi blo gros dang bla 'god la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs 'dir dag tu=/ klu'i rgyal po legs mthong dang shin tu brtan pa la/ klu'i rgyal po mgul na nor bu dang sprin byung ba la=/ klu'i rgyal po char rgyun dang rab 'joms la=/ klu'i rgyal po rnam par 'joms pa dang mthu bsgyings la=/ klu'i rgyal po gdengs ka chen po dang dbyangs zab la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po cher sgrogs dang rnam par sgra 'byin la=/ klu'i rgyal po utpal dang rtsal chen la=/ klu'i rgyal po gzhom mda' 'dzin dang sna tshogs sde la=/ klu'i rgyal po zhags pa chen po dang e la'i 'dab la=/ klu'i rgyal po kun tu snang dang rna rtsub la=/ klu'i rgyal po dung dang da ra da ra la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po urha la da ra da ra dang bde byed la=/ klu'i rgyal po lag 'gro dang lag 'gro chen po la=/ klu'i rgyal po dri ma chen po dang 'phur lding la=/ klu'i rgyal po sog ma med dang phyang ba la mchod cing yang =/

klu'i rgyal po srin bu gnas dang nag po la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po dbang po'i sde dang 'dam bu la=/ klu'i rgyal po nye ba'i 'dam bu dang dung thogs la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'gro lding dang rab mdzes la=/ klu'i rgyal po glang chen dang rnon po la=/ klu'i rgyal po ser skya dang glog 'bebs la=/ klu'i rgyal po glog gi 'od chen po dang stobs lha la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po chu stobs dang dam pa 'gebs la=/ klu'i rgyal po bdud rtsi can dang mu stegs can la=/ klu'i rgyal po baiḍūrya'i 'od can dang mdog ser mdog la=/ klu'i rgyal po gser 'od dang zla ba'i rgyal mtshan la=/ klu'i rgyal po nyi 'od 'char 'od dang ba lang mgo la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po dkar po dang nag po la=/ klu'i rgyal po gshin rje dang dge tshul sbal ba la=/ klu'i rgyal po gzi brjid dang mu khyud 'dzin la=/ klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin dang mgo stong can la=/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu dang dung skyong la=/ yul phyaugs=/ klu'i rgyal po don yod mthong dang sprin chen po la=/ klu'i rgyal po sde bzang dang sa skyong la=/ klu'i rgyal po mes byin dang rnam par bul la=/ klu'i rgyal po rga ba dang chu srin kumbhi ra la=/ klu'i rgyal po chu srin kumbhi ri'i gdong dang rmugs 'dzin la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po myur gdug dang padma ka la=/ klu'i rgyal po mjug ma dang rab 'phyang la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'jigs byed dang gzi brjid mdzes la=/ klu'i rgyal po mgo lnga pa dang pa la li ra la=/ klu'i rgyal po shing rtas rgyal dang rgyal po bla ma la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po mjug ring dang mgo bo che la=/ klu'i rgyal po si ma bi ka dang bi ta ra la=/ klu'i rgyal po mgrogs mgro dang mgo bo gsum pa la=/ klu'i rgyal po klu sde dang gzi chen la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'dam bu byin dang skrag byed la=/

yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po 'od 'bar dang mgo bdun pa la=/ klu'i rgyal po stong chen dang mthong dga' la=/ klu'i rgyal po rab tu chen gtum dang dri med gzi brjid la=/ klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang dang drag po chen po la=/ klu'i rgyal po 'od 'phro phung po dang gtum po la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po khro bo'i drag shul can dang rin chen chu sbyin la=/ klu'i rgyal po chu sbyin sprin chen dang dbang po'i 'od la=/ klu'i rgyal po rkang pas 'thung dang sprin zla la=/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i sprin dang me tog dri chen la=/ klu'i rgyal po ku mu ta'i 'byung gnas dang rin chen mig la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po tog chen po'i rgyal mtshan dang sprin chen snyingapo la=/ klu'i rgyal po kha ba can dang dpal gyi snying po la=/ klu'i rgyal po sprin mthu can dang mtshan mo 'dzin la=/ klu'i rgyal po chu sbyin dang chu sbyin chen po la=/ klu'i rgyal po gzi brjid me 'du dang sprin gyi dbang phyug rgyal po la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po khro med dang sa'i bum pa la=/ klu'i rgyal po klu dbang dang chu 'dzin la=/ klu'i rgyal po sprin gzugs dang ing gi ra'i gdong la=/ klu'i rgyal po gzi brjid can dang sprin las mngon byung la=/ klu'i rgyal po goms stabs mtha' yas dang cha byad mdzes la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po lus chen dang spyad lto la=/ klu'i rgyal po zhi ba dang dpa' ba la=/ klu'i rgyal po gser dan can dang mchog tu brtson la=/ klu'i rgyal po dug drag dang dbyangs snyan la=/ klu'i rgyal po bdud rtsi'i snying po dang rab tu char 'bebs chen po la=/ yul phyogs=/ klu'i rgyal po rnam par g.yo ba dang 'brug sgra la=/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun la=/ klu'i rgyal po dga' byed dang 'brug sgra sgrogs la=/ klu'i rgyal po dpal sde dang sred med kyi bu la=/

klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i klong dang g.yon po la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs=/ de dag la sogs pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams dang klu thams cad la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs 'di dag tu char rab tu phob cig swāhā/ gzhan yang tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la mchod cing =/ yul phyogs=/ rgyal chen bzhi la=/ lha chen brgyad la=/ klu chen brgyad la=/ gza' chen brgyad la=/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la=/ ded dpon dgu la=/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams la=/ lha mi'i drang srong rnams la=/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad la=/ yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la=/ yul phyaugs 'di dag tu=/ gzhan yang klu chen po dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bden pa'i byin gyis 'dzambu'i gling 'dir=/ dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bden pa'i=/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi=/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi=/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi=/ lha klu sde brgyad rnams kyi mthu dang bden pa'i byin gyis=/ mkha' lding thams cad kyi mthu dang bden pa'i=/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i=/ skye 'phags kun dang bdag cag rnams kyi bsod rnams kyi mthus 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swāhā/ de ltar lan gsum dang bdun sogs brjod pa'i sgo nas mchod cing bskul na char 'babs pa'i thabs chen por 'gyur zhing bsgrub sla ba'i so so/ char 'bebs kyi sngags ring mang yang bzhag ste/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sādya the dan/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ nā ga nā gadzi ni dzi ni/ dzu bu dzu bu/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ba ra ba ra/ bi ri bi ri/ bu ru bu ru/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ta la ta la/ ti li ti li/ tu lu tu lu/ gha ma gha ma/ ghi mi ghi mi/ ghu mu ghu mu/

na ra na ra/ ni ri ni ri/ nu ru nu ru/ ga ṭa ga ṭa/ gi ṭi gi ṭi/ gu ṭu gu ṭu/ sha ra sha ra/ shi ri shi ri/ shu ru shu ru/ char gyi bgegs thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swāhā/ zhes bzlas na char 'babs pa'i bgegs zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang bag phye la dkar gsum mngar gsum dang klu sman sna tshogs bsres te ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas/ na ga ka la ka la bha ri sha ya swāhā/ zhes ril bu re la brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas nas bsngags la/ klu yod pa'i chu mig khar blugs na char 'babs bar nges zhes bshad do/ ༈ /ser ba srung ba'i thabs la sbyir ser mnan sogs mang du snang yang*/ da lta grags che ba khyung nag dang*/ drag po lha bzhi'i sgo nas srung mkhan mang la/ 'dir mtshon tsam ni/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las/ oṃ kā lu me lu kā lu me st+waṃ bha yasmi lā ba rṣaṃ tu ṣā rañtsa lutstsha i lutstsha i swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas te thal ba la bsngags nas ser ba 'ong phyogs su gtor na bzlog par bshad/ yang rang khyung du bsgoms te/ oṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas nas dung la bsngags te ser ba 'ong phyogs su bus na log par bshad/ yang*/ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ oṃ he he/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhandha bhandha/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ ni rundha ni rundha/ ser ba urṇā ma ṇi swāhā/ 'di 'bum bzlas te yungs kar dang thal ba dang bye ma sogs la bsngags nas ser ba 'ong phyogs su gtor na zlog cing*/ zhing la gtor na 'bu srin sogs srung bar byed pa dang*/ byang bu sogs la bris nas lo tog phyogs su btsugs na srung bar 'gyur zhes bshad/ yang*/ tadya thā/ shu li/ shu mu li/ sha sha shu shu ti pi ra ti/ hūṃ ya hūṃ ya/ hūṃ ni swāhā/ zhes lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig sogs brjod de ser ba 'ong phyogs su phus gdab cing sprin gtor bar bsams na ser ba zlog ces bshad/ yang*/ oṃ badzra tso ma le hūṃ phaṭa/

ces mang du bzlas nas ser ba byung ba'i tshe rang phyag rdor du bsgoms nas ser ba 'ong phyogs su phus btab pas thub ces bshad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan nas rjod de phyag 'tshal zhing*/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pas sngon smon lam mdzad pa ltar khong gi mthu dang bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis ser ba drag po'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces pa lta bu'i bden brjod byas na ser ba zlog par bshad do/ /gzhan lugs kyi ser ba srung thabs 'ga' re snang yang 'dir ma bkod do/ /yang*/ char chen srung ba'i thabs la gzhan 'ga' re snang mod/ 'dir mtshon tsam zhig ni/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ bde mchog gi nye snying gi bsnyen tshad sngon du legs par btang ba zhig gis/ char che ba'i dus su nam mkha' la lta bzhin du nye snying stong bzlas na char chen po gcod par 'gyur bar bshad/ yang*/ gzhan zhig tu/ ka lu ka me lu ka la ka me lu/ st+waṃ bha ya sho la barṣaṃ kru sha bar shan tsa lū ni swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas nas nam mkha' la phus btab cing mdzub ris byas na chod par bshad/ ༈ yang*/ rang phyag rdor du bsgoms nas/ ka ra ka ra se ra ti sa ta hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa mang du brjod de nam mkha' la phus btab na chod ces bshad/ ༈ yang*/ rdzas kyi srung ba ni/ 'brug lo pa'i skra sen/ wa sha te lo'i sha sprul sha bag phye/ gla rtsi/ ra glo/ khra'i lpags pa rnams bsrais la phub ma'i dkyil du btab nas bsreg pa'i dud pa nam mkha' la btang na chod ces bshad/ gzhan yang nam mkhar rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas sprin gtor ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ oṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le hūṃ zhes sogs kyi sngags ring zhig bzlas par bshad de ma bris/ ༈ yang*/ sad srung na/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ nā ga sha sha shu shu mu li swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas te dkar gsum mngar gsum la bsngags nas klu yod pa'i chu mig tu blugs na sprin 'du zhing sad srung bar 'gyur zhes bshad/

༈ yang*/ zhing la 'bu srin srung na/ srin gyi sbal so sod/ srin gyi nā tsa sod/ srin snying sod/ dar dur drags pa sod/ ces bzlas nas phyai ma la btab ste zhing la gtor na thub ces bshad/ ༈ yang*/ zhing la byi ba srung na/ oṃ ru ru tsu tsu mu ru mu ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas nas/ byi ba kha shar du bstan pa'i byi brun dang*/ yungs kar la btab ste zhing la gtor na/ thub ces bshad do/ / gzhan yang*/ rdo rje'i mchu las char 'bebs dang sad ser 'bu srin sogs srung ba'i skor 'ga' re bshad kyang*/ da lta'i gang zag gis blo bur du bsgrub dka' bar snang bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /ces pa 'di dag kyang don gnyer can gzhan re gnyis la phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis bkod pa'i tshe par gyi yi ge pa ni la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ lo glud du grags pa'i lo rim sde brgyad spyi mchod char 'bebs sad ser bsrung ba dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 332-- PAGE 333-- PAGE 328-
